body.name: LambdaH
body.space: \(\prod_{r\in\mathcal R_H^{\mathrm{act}}}\Delta(\mathcal T_r)\times\prod_{r\in\mathcal R_H^{\mathrm{dorm}}}\Delta(\mathcal T_r)\times\prod_{u\in U}\Delta(\mathcal X_u)\)
body.def: \(\Lambda_H\) is the product of simplices indexed by the primitive natural-response tables, separately tagged active and dormant rows, and explicit latent-root laws retained by \(G_H^N\); it is constructed from those indices before imposing gate-sharing, support, or observation constraints.
